$comment: New Project picker. House defaults stay as marked. Every KKD pack and every KKD sub-skill is optional add-only: default off, visibility search-only. Lab must not dump the leaf list into the default tick panel. Search name/description/tags and show matches as options the designer can tick.

picker.rule: Optional add-only. Nothing KKD is ticked on a new project. The default panel does not list KKD packs or sub-skills. The designer searches; matching packs, plugins, flow skills, and leaf skills appear as ticks they can choose.
